product.name: Ozark Trail Packable Blanket, 70 in x 60 in, Gradient Design, for Camping, Travel and Picnics
product.shortDescription: This Ozark Trail packable blanket gives you a roomy layer for camping, picnics, concerts, and travel.

idml.shortDescription: This Ozark Trail packable blanket gives you a roomy layer for camping, picnics, concerts, and travel. Made with 100% recycled polyester fabrics, it combines a soft quilted top with a durable bottom for more comfortable lounging outdoors. The 70 in x 60 in size gives you space to spread out, share with a friend, or set out food and place settings. When it is time to head out, the blanket packs into the included stuff sack for easy carrying. It is also machine washable, so it is simple to clean and keep ready for the next outing.
idml.longDescription:
• The upper layer is soft and breathable, while the bottom layer adds a durable, protective surface for outdoor use.
  • Quilted construction helps keep the fill in place and helps reduce cold spots across the blanket.
  • Webbed binding creates smooth, secure edges for a clean finished look.
  • Includes a stuff sack with a 7 in x 14 in carry bag size for compact packing and storage.
  • Carry weight is 1.9 lb, making it easier to bring along for day trips and outdoor activities.
